definitions.explanation: The region of the atmosphere above the earth.

examples.english: To look up at the sky.

examples.japanese: {今日|きょう}は{空|そら}がきれいだ。
{夜|よる}の{空|そら}に{星|ほし}が{見|み}える。
examples.english: Stars are visible in the night sky.

examples.japanese: {雨|あめ}が{止|や}んで{空|そら}が{明|あか}るくなってきた。
examples.english: The rain stopped and the sky brightened up.

notes:
{空|そら} means sky—the visible expanse above the earth.

KANJI READINGS:
The kanji {空|くう} has multiple readings with different meanings:
- {空|そら}: sky (native Japanese reading)
- {空|から}: empty (e.g., {空|から}っぽ = empty)
- {空|くう}: void, emptiness (Sino-Japanese, Buddhist)

COMMON COMPOUNDS:
- {青空|あおぞら}: blue sky
- {夜空|よぞら}: night sky
- {大空|おおぞら}: the great sky, heavens
- {空模様|そらもよう}: sky conditions, weather
- {空港|くうこう}: airport
- {空気|くうき}: air, atmosphere
- {空中|くうちゅう}: in the air, midair

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {空|そら}を{見上|みあ}げる: to look up at the sky
- {空|そら}が{曇|くも}る: the sky becomes cloudy
- {空|そら}が{晴|は}れる: the sky clears up

RELATED WORDS:
- {天|てん}: heaven, sky (more literary)
- {雲|くも}: cloud
- {星|ほし}: star
